# mawburn Feed

> Daily and Sunday weekly technology and AI briefings with primary sources, context, caveats and dated archives.

Canonical site: https://mawburn.github.io/tech-feed/
Full human-readable archive: https://mawburn.github.io/tech-feed/archive.md
Machine-readable structured briefing JSON: https://mawburn.github.io/tech-feed/data/briefings.json
Weekly Sunday summaries: https://mawburn.github.io/tech-feed/weekly.html
Weekly machine-readable JSON: https://mawburn.github.io/tech-feed/data/weekly.json
Weekly human-readable archive: https://mawburn.github.io/tech-feed/weekly-archive.md
Repository: https://github.com/mawburn/tech-feed

## How to read
- The newest dated edition is the default view.
- Each issues[].date is the briefing publication date in America/Los_Angeles, not necessarily the original publication date of each story.
- Every issue contains overview, topStories, alsoWorthKnowing, newTools and marketPulse.
- Each story contains a title, editorial summary, category and links to sources. Top stories also describe significance and limits.
- Date and category filters on the homepage are client-side; the JSON and Markdown provide direct access without JavaScript.
- Older editions can contain reconstructed summaries instead of verbatim text; those are labeled.

## Attribution and verification
The summaries are independently authored and may not reflect later corrections. Link to original articles, research papers, repositories and statements whenever possible. A mention is not endorsement or independent verification of vendor claims.

## Sunday weekly recap
- Week periods start Monday and end Sunday in America/Los_Angeles.
- data/weekly.json has schemaVersion, updatedAt and weeks[] newest-first. Each weekly item contains overview, themes, toolsToWatch, marketPulse, nextWeekWatch, sourceDays and coverageDays.
- A partial week explicitly names the daily editions actually available rather than presenting missing days as covered.
- Weekly recaps deduplicate related stories across daily editions and preserve independently readable source links.
- Historical weekly recaps remain available after individual daily editions age out of the rolling seven-day archive.
